flashcard_questions.q: The dynamic external system in which a business competes and functions, shaped by the number and strength of rival firms.
A situation where rival businesses repeatedly lower their prices to undercut each other, often reducing profit margins for everyone involved.
A feature or benefit that makes a business or product better than its competitors in the eyes of the customer.

flashcard_questions.a: A business approach where customer satisfaction is placed at the core of every business decision.
Making a product or service stand out from competitors through design, features, packaging, pricing, location, or service.
